provenance_note: Official file served by the Kantei's own host as a stored static PDF with a fixed Last-Modified (Fri, 13 Mar 2026 13:01:23 GMT), before the cutoff; it carries no per-request token or timestamp, and a cache-busting request returned the same bytes. Found by the part C check, which downloaded it twice on 25 September 2026 (00:17Z-00:58Z and 01:02Z-01:18Z, the live Kantei responses the second time with a cache-busting query) with the same byte count and SHA-256. Downloaded on 25 September 2026 (UTC) by this packet at 01:37:52Z, 01:40:52Z, 01:42:31Z (cache-busting query), 02:21:17Z, each time with the same byte count and SHA-256; at least two downloads were 30 minutes or more apart. Bytes and SHA-256 are of the identity-encoded body, requested without Accept-Encoding (the Diet API and the Internet Archive send gzip when a client asks for it, which changes the transferred bytes but not the content). This checked-in file is a derived factual extract, not a copy of the original response. Original response bodies, PDFs, images and page renders are not checked into this repository. Its own checksum is recorded separately in the packet.

rows.role_title: 内閣総理大臣 — Prime Minister of Japan
rows.text: The minutes of the first cabinet meeting of 18 February 2026 (22:55-23:09), attended by 高市早苗 内閣総理大臣, record the adoption of the Prime Minister's statement, read out by the Deputy Chief Cabinet Secretary: 'この度の総選挙の結果を受け、本日、再び内閣総理大臣の重責を担うこととなりました'.

bounded_scope: Head-of-government observations for CLAUDE-C01-13 only (stacked on CLAUDE-C01-12). Each House's designation vote, any joint committee and the House of Representatives' prevailing resolution, the Imperial appointment ceremony, Kantei statements and accounts, the Official Gazette's appointment and loss-of-office notices, the Cabinet's minutes, a cabinet's formation, its resignation en masse, any continued performance of duties and acting designations stay separate rows; holder boundaries are decided in the packet, not by any row. A null holder_name means the source names no holder of this role: an unnamed statement or schedule row, a House of Councillors designee who never held the office, or a designation of acting ministers. Ministers, deputy prime ministers and party offices are excluded.
